title: Muranda weUchenjeri Hwakavanzika
intro: Munyaya dzakawanda dzeQuran, pane munhu asinganzwisisike, muranda waAllah ane ruzivo rwaMwari netsitsi. Munhu uyu asinganzwisisike akasangana nemumwe wevaprofita vakuru, zvichimutungamirira kurwendo rwakazara nezviito zvinonetsa zvaipikisa miganhu yekunzwisisa kwevanhu. Chiito chimwe nechimwe, kunyange zvazvo chaiita sechisina kururama, chakavanza zvidzidzo zvakadzama nezveramangwana, mwoyo murefu, uye huchenjeri husingaonekwi huri shure kwemurairo waMwari. Ndiani munhu uyu ane mumvuri, uye chokwadi chipi chaakaburitsa pachena?
clues: Ndakanga ndiri mushandi waAllah, ndakasarudzwa nekuda kweruzivo rwakakosha netsitsi.
Muprofita mukuru akaedza kudzidza kubva kwandiri, uye ndakabvuma pasi pemitemo yakaoma.
Pamusangano wedu, ndakaita zvinhu zvitatu zvaiita sezvisina kururama kune mumwe wangu.
Ndakakuvadza chikepe chevarombo, asi chaiva tsitsi dzakavanda.
Ndakauraya mukomana mudiki, kunyange zvazvo zvaiita sekuti ndaive nehutsinye, asi ndaida kudzivirira vabereki vake kusuruvara.
Ndakavakazve rusvingo muguta raitinyima kugamuchira vaenzi, ndichiratidza pfuma pasi parwo.

arabic: فَوَجَدَا عَبْدًۭا مِّنْ عِبَادِنَآ ءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا وَعَلَّمْنَـٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّا عِلْمًۭا
verse: And they found a servant from among Our servants [i.e., al-Khiḍr] to whom We had given mercy from Us and had taught him from Us a [certain] knowledge. (18:65)
